data.name: Daleela
data.gender_notes: Daleela is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘dalila’, meaning ‘guide’ or ‘she who guides’. In Islamic contexts, Daleela is a spiritual name, evoking images of compassion, patience, and tenderness. This name is often given to girls as a reminder of their role as spiritual guides and nurturers in their families and communities. The name Daleela carries the meaning “Delicate, tender, or gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daleela usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, tender, or gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing compassion and spiritual guidance in Islam.
data.etymology: Daleela belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, tender, or gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daleela total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
